title: Food, Biographies & Past-Time Revision
subtitle: Three focused revision units from your lesson

units.title: Food, Restaurants & Quantity
units.tagline: Order clearly and choose the right quantity word.
notes: Food vocabulary from the lesson: cheese, fish, meat, beef, beans, chicken, eggs, milk, banana, tomato, cucumber, apple, chocolate, bread, oil, sugar, salt and pepper.
Restaurant sequence: read the menu, choose a starter, main course and dessert, place an order, then ask for the bill and leave a tip.
Useful lesson language: “May I order, please?”, “Can I have a chicken salad?”, “Anything else?”, “Enjoy your meal.” and “Can I get the bill, please?”
Diet and preference words: guilty pleasure, salmon, French fries, biscuits, strawberry, grape, peach, honey, butter, crisps, carrot and nuts.
units.remember: Olumlu cümlelerde something, çoğu soru ve olumsuz cümlede anything kullanılır. Fiil olumlu olduğu hâlde cümleye olumsuz anlam vermek için nothing kullanılır.
units.watchOut: İki olumsuz yapıyı birlikte kullanma: “I don’t want anything” veya “I want nothing” doğrudur; “I don’t want nothing” yanlıştır.

vocabulary.meaning: food from the sea, such as fish or shellfish
vocabulary.example: My favorite food is seafood.
What would you like for a starter?

vocabulary.meaning: the largest or central part of a meal
vocabulary.example: I ordered salmon for the main course.

vocabulary.meaning: food prepared in a particular way
vocabulary.example: This bean dish is very popular.

vocabulary.meaning: the amount you must pay in a restaurant
vocabulary.example: Can I get the bill, please?

vocabulary.meaning: to ask for food or drink
vocabulary.example: I usually order sushi in a restaurant.
I usually leave a tip.

vocabulary.meaning: something you enjoy although it may not be healthy or sensible
vocabulary.example: Spicy crisps are my guilty pleasure.

vocabulary.meaning: thin fried potato slices; British English
vocabulary.example: I like spicy and salted crisps.

vocabulary.meaning: a liquid fat used in cooking
vocabulary.example: We do not need much oil.
I do not like beef.
The chef prepared the main course.

grammar.title: Indefinite pronouns
grammar.rule: Someone/something/somewhere çoğunlukla olumlu anlamlarda; anyone/anything/anywhere ise çoğunlukla soru ve olumsuz cümlelerde kullanılır. No one/nothing/nowhere, olumlu yapıdaki bir fiille birlikte cümleye olumsuz anlam verir.
examples: Would you like something to drink?
There is nothing on the menu for me.

grammar.title: Many, much and a lot of
grammar.rule: Many sayılabilen çoğul isimlerle, much sayılamayan isimlerle kullanılır. A lot of ise her ikisiyle de kullanılabilir. Much özellikle soru ve olumsuz cümlelerde yaygındır.
examples: How many apples do we need?
How much oil do we need?
We have a lot of tomatoes.
I do not eat much chocolate.

grammar.title: Countable or uncountable?
grammar.rule: Tek tek nesneler sayılabilir; ancak maddeler ve genel yiyecek kategorileri çoğu zaman sayılamaz.

practice.prompt: There is ___ in the fridge. It is completely empty.
practice.hint: The verb is positive but the meaning is negative.

practice.prompt: I do not add ___ sugar to my tea.

options: Can I get the bill, please?
practice.answer: Can I get the bill, please?
practice.hint: Use get for a polite request.

options: I usually order sushi in a restaurant.
The restaurant usually order sushi me.
practice.answer: I usually order sushi in a restaurant.

practice.prompt: Which word means the first small course?
practice.hint: It comes before the main course.

practice.prompt: Which is an uncountable food noun here?
practice.hint: It is a general type of meat.

reading.title: Berra Orders Dinner
reading.text: Berra visits a small seafood restaurant with a friend. She looks at the menu and chooses a bean salad for her starter. For the main course, she orders salmon with carrots and bread. Her friend asks for a steak, but Berra does not want any beef. The waiter asks, “Would you like anything else?” Berra orders a drink but says she does not need any dessert because she does not like much chocolate. Her friend chooses biscuits with strawberries and honey. At the end of the meal, Berra says, “Can I get the bill, please?” The service was friendly, so they leave a tip for the waiter. On the way home, Berra buys some spicy crisps. She laughs and calls them her guilty pleasure.

questions.prompt: What does Berra order for her starter?
Why does she not order beef?
options: She does not want any beef.
questions.answer: She does not want any beef.

questions.prompt: What does her friend have for dessert?
Why do they leave a tip?
What is Berra's guilty pleasure in the text?

test.prompt: I did not see ___ on the dessert menu.
Which course comes after the starter?

Which sentence avoids a double negative?

units.title: Biographies, Past BE & Time
units.tagline: Place people and events clearly in the past.
notes: Biography vocabulary: be born, emperor, poet, rich, poor, cheap, expensive, genius, creator and successful.
History vocabulary from the lesson: unfortunately, probably, last, yesterday, die, marry, compose, kill, promise, work and listener.
Question distinction from class: “Where can you read a biography?” asks for a place, not which biography you read.
Useful model: “I can read the biography of a famous person in the library.”
units.remember: I/he/she/it ile was; you/we/they ile were kullanılır. Be born kalıbında özneye göre was veya were seçilir: She was born; they were born.
units.watchOut: Last veya yesterday ifadelerinden önce zaman edatı kullanma: yesterday, last week ve last year doğrudur; on yesterday veya in last year yanlıştır.

vocabulary.example: The poet was born in 1990.

vocabulary.meaning: the story of a person's life written by someone else
vocabulary.example: I read a biography in the library.

vocabulary.meaning: the male ruler of an empire
vocabulary.example: The emperor was powerful.
She was a successful poet.

vocabulary.meaning: a person with exceptional ability or intelligence
vocabulary.example: People called the creator a genius.

vocabulary.meaning: a person who makes or invents something
vocabulary.example: The creator was famous.
Her first book was successful.

vocabulary.meaning: used to introduce bad or disappointing information
vocabulary.example: Unfortunately, the plan did not work.

vocabulary.meaning: very likely, but not completely certain
vocabulary.example: He was probably at home.
She composed music for many listeners.

grammar.title: Past Simple of BE
grammar.rule: Olumlu cümlede I/he/she/it ile was; you/we/they ile were kullanılır. Olumsuz biçimler was not/wasn’t ve were not/weren’t şeklindedir. Sorularda BE fiili öznenin önüne geçer.

grammar.title: Be born
grammar.rule: İngilizcede be born kalıbı geçmiş zamanda normalde was/were born şeklinde kullanılır; born tek başına veya did born şeklinde kullanılmaz.

grammar.title: Prepositions of time
grammar.rule: Kesin saatlerle at, günler ve tarihlerle on, aylar, yıllar ve daha uzun zaman dilimleriyle in kullanılır.

grammar.title: No preposition
grammar.rule: Yesterday; last night/week/month/year ve this/next ile kurulan zaman ifadeleri at, on veya in almadan kullanılır.

practice.hint: Put past BE before the subject.
Use at with a clock time.

practice.prompt: Which answer gives a place? Where can you read a biography?

reading.title: A Fictional Poet's Biography
reading.text: Mira Deniz was born in a poor village in 1988. Her family was not rich, but there were many books in their small home. Mira was a quiet child and a careful listener. In the evenings, she wrote short poems about her family and the natural world. At university, her books were cheap to print, but they were not immediately successful. She worked in a café during the day and composed songs at night. In 2015, a musician read one of her poems and used it in a song. The song was successful, and more readers discovered Mira's work. She married her university friend in 2018. Unfortunately, her first international event was cancelled, but she continued writing. People probably remember her because she was honest about ordinary life, not because she tried to appear like a genius.

questions.prompt: What was in her family home?
What did she do at night?
Why do people probably remember her?
options: She wrote honestly about ordinary life.
questions.answer: She wrote honestly about ordinary life.

test.prompt: A person who writes poems is a ___.
Which word shows bad or disappointing news?
Which means very likely but not certain?

units.title: Past Actions: Regular & Irregular
units.tagline: Tell complete stories with accurate past forms.
notes: Regular past verbs raised in the lesson: work → worked, listen → listened, promise → promised, compose → composed, marry → married, die → died and kill → killed.
Irregular verb revision heard in class: become → became, buy → bought, drink → drank, come → came, get → got, say → said, see → saw, take → took, tell → told and think → thought.
Past Simple questions and negatives use did/didn't plus the base form: Did she compose? She didn't compose.
The learner successfully recalled several irregular pairs but needed more contextual sentence practice.
units.remember: Did veya didn’t sonrasında ana fiil yalın hâline döner: Did he go? He didn’t go.
units.watchOut: Yazım değişikliklerine dikkat et: marry → married, die → died, promise → promised. Düzensiz fiillerin yalın ve geçmiş zaman biçimleri birlikte öğrenilmelidir.

vocabulary.example: She became successful.
They bought him a new car.
He drank milk.

vocabulary.meaning: move toward a place or person
vocabulary.example: The waiter came to the table.
We got the bill.
She said the meal was good.
I saw a famous poet.
The waiter took our order.
He told us a strange story.
I thought the dish was expensive.

grammar.title: Regular Past Simple
grammar.rule: Çoğu fiile -ed eklenir. Son harfi e olan fiillere -d eklenir; sessiz harf + y ile bitenlerde y, -ied olur. Kısa ve vurgulu bir ünlüden sonra bazı son sessiz harfler çift yazılır.

grammar.title: Irregular Past Simple
grammar.rule: Düzensiz fiiller tek bir yazım kuralını izlemez. Bu nedenle fiilin yalın hâli ile geçmiş zaman biçimini birlikte öğren.

grammar.title: Questions and negatives
grammar.rule: Sorularda did + özne + fiilin yalın hâli; olumsuz cümlelerde özne + didn’t + fiilin yalın hâli kullanılır.

practice.hint: After did, use the base form.
After did not, use the base form.

options: I thought the dish was expensive.
I thinked the dish was expensive.
I did thought the dish was expensive.
practice.answer: I thought the dish was expensive.

reading.title: A Strange Saturday
reading.text: Last Saturday, Ada went to a new restaurant with her cousin. They came early and saw only one waiter. Ada thought the restaurant was closed, but the waiter smiled and gave them a menu. Her cousin ordered steak, and Ada bought a small bean dish and bread. The chef came out of the kitchen and told them that they were the first customers of the day. He promised to prepare a special dessert. While they waited, Ada saw an old photograph of a famous poet on the wall. The waiter said the poet visited the restaurant many years ago and composed a short song there. After dinner, the waiter brought honey biscuits and strawberries. Ada did not eat much dessert, but she thought it was delicious. They got the bill, left a tip and went home with a strange but happy story.

questions.prompt: Why did Ada first think the restaurant was closed?
Who was in the old photograph?
What did they do before going home?
options: They got the bill and left a tip.
questions.answer: They got the bill and left a tip.
